title: Client Mods
description: This pack uses over 150 client side mods that improve your game experience.
body:
# ****Client Mods 1.21****
This Modpack features over 100 individually selected client-side mods to enhance your Minecraft experience more than any other modpack without adding unnecessary bloat.
## Key Features:

- Graphics: ClientMods features many Graphics Mods to let you use Shaders, get overhauled texture features that vanilla doesn't offer, etc.

- Performance: The Modpack includes dozens of performance mods to take your performance to levels you'd never have imagined possible!

- User Interface & Experiece: We've added countless mods to help you navigate containers, guis, etc. more easily and also added mods to provide you with new QoL features that will help you navigate your world.

- Animations: ClientMods includes multiple mods that take your player animations to a whole new level: Every part of the game now looks more cinematic than anything you've ever seen!

- Sounds: This pack features many mods that add new sounds to your game and overhaul preexisting ones to make your game feel truly alive!
